_comment: WI-A11. The enumeration ADR-001 D1 asserts but did not, until 2026-08-03, name.
`anchor` = the passage STATES the rule as an obligation binding on a profile
definition. `reference` = it applies, illustrates, or discusses the rule. The
split is a judgement, which is exactly why every entry carries a named reviewer;
the check verifies the curation has not drifted, it does not re-derive it.
Passages are identified by HASH, not by line. `line` is a hint for a reader and
a stale hint is reported, never failed on — the ADR is amended regularly and a
line-keyed check would go red on every unrelated edit, which trains people to
Hashes cover the whole paragraph with whitespace collapsed, so a reflow is not
drift but any changed word is. Re-baselining is `--emit`, and a re-emitted hash
still needs a reviewer to accept that the new formulation states the predicate.
